svg.title: FIG-21 Native RTC/LPTIM: assembly and final access Solid: current Native; dashed: future hardware target
svg.desc: CURRENT runtime: one serialized Native owner per instance; External serialized task executor; Public RTC / LPTIM face immutable ops + instance context; Independent private Native state shared readonly ops; one active request; Copied Core clock face borrowed context stays live and disjoint; Explicit host model advancement source only; no request publication; Calendar / finite counter source armed and pending facts; Stop closes admission immediately A retained loan can still need drain; Closed; no active / armed / pending / terminal Caller still proves external joins; Explicit PRIVATE start check full owner; retained BUSY first then constructed + closed + generation room; Rejected start leaves all owner bytes unchanged INVALID / BUSY / STATE / EXHAUSTED; public task calls; no implicit worker; dispatch ops(context, ...); reads finite deadlines only when required; serialized host-only control; bounded advancement; no Core time change; lifecycle rule; clean stop or actual retained-source withdrawal; explicit private call after external joins; SUCCESS: generation++ before opened=true preserve calendar/rate/clock/fault; checks fail; no clock read/source progress; CURRENT: protocol actions; ACTIVE / QUARANTINED / SETTLED are request states; READY: caller storage initialized and unborrowed; ACTIVE: provider borrows the complete immutable request; Latch first terminal cause service / cancel / stop can withdraw; QUARANTINED: hold prevents withdrawal request and owner remain live; Withdrawal proved source off; pending clear; active detached LPTIM: final ticks copied; generation advanced; SETTLED: release publication provider final request access; REJECTED: no loan or source effects; submit SUCCESS = ACCEPTED; explicit service observation / cancel / stop; armed source + hold; real public retry; cause unchanged; withdrawal permitted; only after every required reference detaches; consume result + external joins, then prepare; retains exact request identity; private start returns BUSY; never revoke the loan; only when a prior stop closed admission; Core deadline observation only; no source advancement; service observes pending event expiry wins only if no earlier cause is latched; source can keep progressing during hold LPTIM result uses final withdrawal ticks; CURRENT build: ordinary typed configuration and static assembly; Ordinary [rtc.name] / [lptim.name] Native RTC0/1 and LPTIM0/1, no pins/IRQ; Existing ControllerIR -> provider path no second configuration authority; Generated nx_platform_start/stop explicit external lifecycle, no scheduler; Emit selected static state/faces and pure typed factory lookup; build: strict validation and resource claims; build: static emission through existing providers; runtime lookup returns an existing face lookup performs no initialization; build: emits existing lifecycle entry points; explicit start/stop; inspect outcomes; first preparation: construct once; later preparation: private start of constructed owner; public port stop; retain failed cleanup; TARGET: physical adaptation, not implemented or executed; H743 / U575 RTC + LPTIM clock / backup reset / IRQ / STOP / VBAT No hardware or HIL qualification; future provider must meet the public contract
